### Root Cause

On restricted workflows (ADO Test Case / ADO PBI), the test-automation statuses (`Passed`, `Failed`, `In Review - Passed/Failed`, `Skipped`, `Irrelevant`, `Bug To Fix`, `In Testing`, `Ready For Testing`, `Merged`) are tag-only. ~25 modules moved tickets with raw `tracker.moveToStatus(...)`, so ADO rejected the transition and the call sites swallowed the error — no status change, no `stage_*` marker, and `✅ Moved …` logs that lied. The shipped SM rules made it worse: their JQL gated on the same statuses, so tickets carrying only a `stage_*` marker were invisible, and `smAgent`'s `rule.targetStatus` move (Merged → Ready For Testing) hit the same raw call.

### Fix

- `js/common/trackers.js`: added `hasStage(ticket, stageKey, statusName)` — status match, or (label mode only) the `stage_<key>` marker; no label reads in the default `'none'` mode.
- Migrated every test-automation mover to `moveToStatusOrMark(key, STATUS, STAGE_KEY)` (`moveToInTesting`, `moveToReadyForTesting`, `post*Results`, `mergeStoryTestAutomationPR`, `retryMergePR`, `prepareTestPRForReview`, `check*Passed`, `checkBugToFixReady`, `checkTaskStoriesDone`, `finishTestCasesGeneration`, `storyTestAutomationRework`, `triggerBitriseTestAutomation`, `recover*`, `postBugCreation`, `postBulkBugsCreation`, `createBugFixBatchEpic`); dev-flow statuses (Done, Blocked, In Rework, In Review, Backlog, …) stay direct moves.
- Status-equality gates in the check/merge/PR modules now resolve through `hasStage(...)`.
- `sm.json` (≡ `agents/sm.json`), `agents/sm_merge.json`, `agents/bulk_bugs_creation.json`: tag-only-status gates switched to whole-clause `{stage.X:Literal}` placeholders; in `'none'` mode single-status rules expand byte-identical, two-status rules to the equivalent `status in ('A') OR status in ('B')`.
- `js/smAgent.js`: `rule.targetStatus` resolves against the tag-only stage set and falls back to `moveToStatusOrMark`; `js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js` mirrors `testRunner.js`'s `makeDefaultConfigLoaderMock` helpers.

Opt-in via the existing `jira.stageFallback: 'label'` / `customParams.stageFallback`; default `'none'` keeps today's behaviour.

### Test Coverage

- Reproduction tests per flow: rejected transitions in `'label'` mode now mark `stage_*` and the flow completes (e.g. `test_moveToInTesting`, `test_mergeStoryTestAutomationPR`, `test_retryMergePR`, `test_recoverMergedPRTicket`, `test_smAgent` targetStatus suites); `'none'`-mode tests pin the unchanged path.
- Full suite: 136 files from `run_all.json` — result recorded below.

### Notes

- `agents/` here is a self-symlink (consumer-layout shim, gitignored) — `sm.json` and `agents/sm.json` are one file.
- Two-status `{stage.*}` rules expand to two OR-ed clauses instead of one two-value `status in (...)` — same selection, different bytes, in `'none'` mode too.
- One pre-existing node-harness failure in `test_smAgent.js` (`assert.doesNotThrow` exists only in the GraalJS runner) is unrelated.

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On trackers whose workflow lacks the Jira-style statuses used by the test-automation pipeline (ADO Test Case: `Design`/`Ready`/`Closed`; ADO PBI/Bug: `New`…`Done`), every test-automation status "move" to a tag-only status (`PASSED`, `FAILED`, `IN_REVIEW_PASSED`, `IN_REVIEW_FAILED`, `SKIPPED`, `IRRELEVANT`, `BUG_TO_FIX`, `IN_TESTING`, `READY_FOR_TESTING`, `MERGED`) silently no-ops, and downstream status gates/queries never match.

**Root cause**: ~25 modules in `js/` call the tracker's raw `moveToStatus(key, STATUS)` (instead of the safe `moveToStatusOrMark(key, STATUS, stageKey)` introduced in agents#855/#856, PR #914) with status values that are not real states on restricted workflows. ADO rejects the transition; most call sites catch the error, `console.warn`, and continue — so the ticket's real state never changes, no `stage_<key>` label is recorded, and the `✅ Moved …` success logs lie. The same gap exists on the query side: shipped SM rules (`sm.json`, `agents/sm_merge.json`, `agents/bulk_bugs_creation.json`) gated their JQL on `{status.<TAG_ONLY>:Literal}` — in label mode a ticket carrying only the `stage_*` marker can never match — and `smAgent.moveStatus` moved `rule.targetStatus` (sm.json moves Merged → `Ready For Testing`) through the same raw `moveToStatus`. Status-equality gates (`checkStoryTestsPassed.js`, `checkBugTestsPassed.js`, `retryMergePR.js`, `prepareTestPRForReview.js:resolveFinalStatus`, `mergeStoryTestAutomationPR.js:resolveFinalStatus`) and WIQL/JQL filters built from the same statuses (`createBugFixBatchEpic.js` `bugStillRelevant`) can then never match, stalling the whole chain (`bug_fix_batch_coordinator` finds "no relevant bugs" forever).

**Impact**: Test-automation / merge / rework SM flows on restricted-workflow trackers (ADO Test Case, ADO PBI) silently stall or repeat; `bug_fix_batch_coordinator` never batches any bug. On Jira/GitHub deployments and in default `stageFallback: 'none'` mode nothing changes — the gap only bites where the workflow does not contain those statuses.

**Fix approach** (backward compatible, opt-in via the existing `jira.stageFallback: 'label'` / `customParams.stageFallback` switch):
1. Add `tracker.hasStage(ticket, stageKey, statusName)` to `js/common/trackers.js`: true when `ticket.status === statusName` or (label mode only) the ticket carries `stageLabel(stageKey)`. No label reads, no behaviour change in `'none'` mode.
2. Replace direct `moveToStatus(key, STATUS)` with `moveToStatusOrMark(key, STATUS, '<STAGE_KEY>')` (no `previousStageKey` — PR #914 sweeps stale labels) at every test-automation call site whose target status can be tag-only: the per-stage movers (`moveToInTesting`, `moveToReadyForTesting`), result posters (`postStoryTestAutomationResults`, `postTestAutomationResults`, `postMobileTestAutomationResults`, `postTestReworkResults`, `postBugCreation`, `postBulkBugsCreation`), merge/review flow (`mergeStoryTestAutomationPR`, `retryMergePR`, `prepareTestPRForReview`, `checkStoryTestsPassed`, `checkBugTestsPassed`, `checkBugToFixReady`, `checkTaskStoriesDone`, `finishTestCasesGeneration`, `storyTestAutomationRework`, `triggerBitriseTestAutomation`), recovery movers (`recoverFailedTCBugStatus`, `recoverMergedPRTicket`, `recoverStuckTestCase`) and `createBugFixBatchEpic`. Moves to statuses that exist everywhere (`DONE`, `BLOCKED`, `IN_REWORK`, `READY_FOR_DEVELOPMENT`, `IN_REVIEW`, `BACKLOG`, …) stay direct. Existing `try/catch` blocks stay — `moveToStatusOrMark` only changes the outcome in label mode.
3. Status-equality gates in `checkStoryTestsPassed`, `checkBugTestsPassed`, `retryMergePR`, `prepareTestPRForReview`, `mergeStoryTestAutomationPR` go through `hasStage(...)`.
4. Query gates: `createBugFixBatchEpic.js` builds its Test-Case relevance WIQL/JQL through `configLoader.interpolateStagePlaceholders` (`{stage.FAILED:…}` / `{stage.BUG_TO_FIX:…}`); the shipped SM rule templates (`sm.json` ≡ `agents/sm.json`, `agents/sm_merge.json`, `agents/bulk_bugs_creation.json`) switch their tag-only-status gates from `{status.X:Lit}` to whole-clause `{stage.X:Lit}` forms. In `'none'` mode single-placeholder rules produce the byte-identical clause; two-status rules become the semantically equal `status in ('A') OR status in ('B')` (the stage machinery cannot emit a two-value `in` — accepted, behaviour-preserving).
5. `smAgent.moveStatus` resolves `rule.targetStatus` against the configured statuses restricted to the tag-only stage set and calls `moveToStatusOrMark`; unconfigured/dev-flow targets keep the plain move. The success log (`✅ … → …`) prints after `moved || marked` — a rejected transition whose marker also failed throws inside `moveToStatusOrMark` and surfaces as the existing warn.

**Previous attempt**: none — first implementation of #910 (builds on #907, fixed by PR #914: `moveToStatusOrMark` sweeps every stale `stage_*` label, so call sites can omit `previousStageKey`).

**CRAP ratchet**: no function's CRAP complexity increases; new helpers stay linear, migrations replace a call, not add branches.

**Test harness note**: `js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js` (the degraded node mirror of the GraalJS `testRunner.js`) lacked the `makeDefaultConfigLoaderMock`/`makeDefaultJiraConfig` suite globals; they are mirrored from `testRunner.js` so the recover*/check* suites run under the node harness too.
"}

{"content":"### Root Cause

On restricted workflows (ADO Test Case / ADO PBI), the test-automation statuses (`Passed`, `Failed`, `In Review - Passed/Failed`, `Skipped`, `Irrelevant`, `Bug To Fix`, `In Testing`, `Ready For Testing`, `Merged`) are tag-only. ~25 modules moved tickets with raw `tracker.moveToStatus(...)`, so ADO rejected the transition and the call sites swallowed the error — no status change, no `stage_*` marker, and `✅ Moved …` logs that lied. The shipped SM rules made it worse: their JQL gated on the same statuses, so tickets carrying only a `stage_*` marker were invisible, and `smAgent`'s `rule.targetStatus` move (Merged → Ready For Testing) hit the same raw call.

### Fix

- `js/common/trackers.js`: added `hasStage(ticket, stageKey, statusName)` — status match, or (label mode only) the `stage_<key>` marker; no label reads in the default `'none'` mode.
- Migrated every test-automation mover to `moveToStatusOrMark(key, STATUS, STAGE_KEY)` (`moveToInTesting`, `moveToReadyForTesting`, `post*Results`, `mergeStoryTestAutomationPR`, `retryMergePR`, `prepareTestPRForReview`, `check*Passed`, `checkBugToFixReady`, `checkTaskStoriesDone`, `finishTestCasesGeneration`, `storyTestAutomationRework`, `triggerBitriseTestAutomation`, `recover*`, `postBugCreation`, `postBulkBugsCreation`, `createBugFixBatchEpic`); dev-flow statuses (Done, Blocked, In Rework, In Review, Backlog, …) stay direct moves.
- Status-equality gates in the check/merge/PR modules now resolve through `hasStage(...)`.
- `sm.json` (≡ `agents/sm.json`), `agents/sm_merge.json`, `agents/bulk_bugs_creation.json`: tag-only-status gates switched to whole-clause `{stage.X:Literal}` placeholders; in `'none'` mode single-status rules expand byte-identical, two-status rules to the equivalent `status in ('A') OR status in ('B')`.
- `js/smAgent.js`: `rule.targetStatus` resolves against the tag-only stage set and falls back to `moveToStatusOrMark`; `js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js` mirrors `testRunner.js`'s `makeDefaultConfigLoaderMock` helpers.

Opt-in via the existing `jira.stageFallback: 'label'` / `customParams.stageFallback`; default `'none'` keeps today's behaviour.

### Test Coverage

- Reproduction tests per flow: rejected transitions in `'label'` mode now mark `stage_*` and the flow completes (e.g. `test_moveToInTesting`, `test_mergeStoryTestAutomationPR`, `test_retryMergePR`, `test_recoverMergedPRTicket`, `test_smAgent` targetStatus suites); `'none'`-mode tests pin the unchanged path.
- Full suite: 136 files from `run_all.json` — result recorded below.

- `agents/` here is a self-symlink (consumer-layout shim, gitignored) — `sm.json` and `agents/sm.json` are one file.
- Two-status `{stage.*}` rules expand to two OR-ed clauses instead of one two-value `status in (...)` — same selection, different bytes, in `'none'` mode too.
- One pre-existing node-harness failure in `test_smAgent.js` (`assert.doesNotThrow` exists only in the GraalJS runner) is unrelated.

blocks.text:
The `test_cases_generator.json` rule's jql is `status in ('{stage.MERGED:Merged}')` — QUOTED form (my sed replaced only the placeholder inside the existing quotes, not the surrounding clause). The `{stage.*}` expansion emits a FULL clause `status in ('Merged')` — nested inside the template's quotes → broken: `status in ('status in ('Merged')`.

CRITICAL: I must rewrite each migrated rule's jql so the stage placeholder REPLACES the whole `status in (...)` clause, not sit inside quotes. My sed only renamed `{status.` → `{stage.` leaving `status in ('{stage.MERGED:Merged}')`.

Check all 17 rules' shapes: most are `status in ('{stage.X:Lit}', '{stage.Y:Lit}')` — ALL broken this way. The PO_REVIEW rule (pre-existing) is `AND {stage.PO_REVIEW:PO Review}` — whole-clause form (that's why its assertion passed).

Fix: transform every `status in ('{stage.X:Lit}'(, '{stage.Y:Lit}')*)` → `{stage.X:Lit}( OR {stage.Y:Lit})`? NO — careful: a single `{stage.X:Lit}` expands to `(status in ('X') OR labels = 'stage_x')`. TWO placeholders need ONE status-in + ONE labels OR-combined: `(status in ('X','Y') OR labels = 'stage_x' OR labels = 'stage_y')` — but the current machinery can't express that from two placeholders: `{stage.X} OR {stage.Y}` → `(status in ('X') OR labels='stage_x') OR (status in ('Y') OR labels='stage_y')` — semantically EQUIVALENT selection (union of both clauses; OR is associative). Double-nested parens fine for JQL/WIQL.

So transformation per jql:
- `status in ('{stage.A:L1}')` → `{stage.A:L1}`
- `status in ('{stage.A:L1}', '{stage.B:L2}')` → `({stage.A:L1} OR {stage.B:L2})`
- bulk_bugs_creation: already whole-clause (`AND {stage.FAILED:Failed}`) ✓ (I did that one correctly).

Note: `status not in (...)` forms — check none of the stage rules use `not in`. From the earlier grep, stage rules are all `status in (...)`. The `status not in ({status.DONE:Done})` line 40 stays status-form ✓.

Also WIQL/jqlByTracker? None.

sed transformation: handle the 1-placeholder and 2-placeholder cases:
`s/status in ('{stage.\([A-Z_]*\):\([^)]*\)}')/{stage.\1:\2}/g` — handles single and both occurrences inside a 2-list? For the 2-placeholder form: `status in ('{stage.A:L1}', '{stage.B:L2}')` — first the inner pattern `'{stage.A:L1}'` and `'{stage.B:L2}'` each become `{stage.A:L1}` and `{stage.B:L2}`, yielding `status in ({stage.A:L1}, {stage.B:L2})`. That's not the OR form I designed — `status in (` remains!

Better: replace the full `status in ('{stage.A:L1}', '{stage.B:L2}')` → `({stage.A:L1} OR {stage.B:L2})` first, then the single form.

sed:
1. `s/status in ('{stage\.\([A-Z0-9_]*\):\([^}]*\)}', '{stage\.\([A-Z0-9_]*\):\([^}]*\)}')/({stage.\1:\2} OR {stage.\3:\4})/g`
2. `s/status in ('{stage\.\([A-Z0-9_]*\):\([^}]*\)}')/{stage.\1:\2}/g`

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On trackers whose workflow lacks the Jira-style statuses used by the test-automation pipeline (ADO Test Case: `Design`/`Ready`/`Closed`; ADO PBI/Bug: `New`…`Done`), every test-automation status "move" to a tag-only status (`PASSED`, `FAILED`, `IN_REVIEW_PASSED`, `IN_REVIEW_FAILED`, `SKIPPED`, `IRRELEVANT`, `BUG_TO_FIX`, `IN_TESTING`, `READY_FOR_TESTING`, `MERGED`) silently no-ops, and downstream status gates/queries never match.

**Root cause**: ~25 modules in `js/` call the tracker's raw `moveToStatus(key, STATUS)` (instead of the safe `moveToStatusOrMark(key, STATUS, stageKey)` introduced in agents#855/#856, PR #914) with status values that are not real states on restricted workflows. ADO rejects the transition; most call sites catch the error, `console.warn`, and continue — so the ticket's real state never changes, no `stage_<key>` label is recorded, and the `✅ Moved …` success logs lie. The same gap exists on the query side: shipped SM rules (`sm.json`, `agents/sm_merge.json`, `agents/bulk_bugs_creation.json`) gated their JQL on `{status.<TAG_ONLY>:Literal}` — in label mode a ticket carrying only the `stage_*` marker can never match — and `smAgent.moveStatus` moved `rule.targetStatus` (sm.json moves Merged → `Ready For Testing`) through the same raw `moveToStatus`. Status-equality gates (`checkStoryTestsPassed.js`, `checkBugTestsPassed.js`, `retryMergePR.js`, `prepareTestPRForReview.js:resolveFinalStatus`, `mergeStoryTestAutomationPR.js:resolveFinalStatus`) and WIQL/JQL filters built from the same statuses (`createBugFixBatchEpic.js` `bugStillRelevant`) can then never match, stalling the whole chain (`bug_fix_batch_coordinator` finds "no relevant bugs" forever).

**Impact**: Test-automation / merge / rework SM flows on restricted-workflow trackers (ADO Test Case, ADO PBI) silently stall or repeat; `bug_fix_batch_coordinator` never batches any bug. On Jira/GitHub deployments and in default `stageFallback: 'none'` mode nothing changes — the gap only bites where the workflow does not contain those statuses.

**Fix approach** (backward compatible, opt-in via the existing `jira.stageFallback: 'label'` / `customParams.stageFallback` switch):
1. Add `tracker.hasStage(ticket, stageKey, statusName)` to `js/common/trackers.js`: true when `ticket.status === statusName` or (label mode only) the ticket carries `stageLabel(stageKey)`. No label reads, no behaviour change in `'none'` mode.
2. Replace direct `moveToStatus(key, STATUS)` with `moveToStatusOrMark(key, STATUS, '<STAGE_KEY>')` (no `previousStageKey` — PR #914 sweeps stale labels) at every test-automation call site whose target status can be tag-only: the per-stage movers (`moveToInTesting`, `moveToReadyForTesting`), result posters (`postStoryTestAutomationResults`, `postTestAutomationResults`, `postMobileTestAutomationResults`, `postTestReworkResults`, `postBugCreation`, `postBulkBugsCreation`), merge/review flow (`mergeStoryTestAutomationPR`, `retryMergePR`, `prepareTestPRForReview`, `checkStoryTestsPassed`, `checkBugTestsPassed`, `checkBugToFixReady`, `checkTaskStoriesDone`, `finishTestCasesGeneration`, `storyTestAutomationRework`, `triggerBitriseTestAutomation`), recovery movers (`recoverFailedTCBugStatus`, `recoverMergedPRTicket`, `recoverStuckTestCase`) and `createBugFixBatchEpic`. Moves to statuses that exist everywhere (`DONE`, `BLOCKED`, `IN_REWORK`, `READY_FOR_DEVELOPMENT`, `IN_REVIEW`, `BACKLOG`, …) stay direct. Existing `try/catch` blocks stay — `moveToStatusOrMark` only changes the outcome in label mode.
3. Status-equality gates in `checkStoryTestsPassed`, `checkBugTestsPassed`, `retryMergePR`, `prepareTestPRForReview`, `mergeStoryTestAutomationPR` go through `hasStage(...)`.
4. Query gates: `createBugFixBatchEpic.js` builds its Test-Case relevance WIQL/JQL through `configLoader.interpolateStagePlaceholders` (`{stage.FAILED:…}` / `{stage.BUG_TO_FIX:…}`); the shipped SM rule templates (`sm.json` ≡ `agents/sm.json`, `agents/sm_merge.json`, `agents/bulk_bugs_creation.json`) switch their tag-only-status gates from `{status.X:Lit}` to whole-clause `{stage.X:Lit}` forms. In `'none'` mode single-placeholder rules produce the byte-identical clause; two-status rules become the semantically equal `status in ('A') OR status in ('B')` (the stage machinery cannot emit a two-value `in` — accepted, behaviour-preserving).
5. `smAgent.moveStatus` resolves `rule.targetStatus` against the configured statuses restricted to the tag-only stage set and calls `moveToStatusOrMark`; unconfigured/dev-flow targets keep the plain move. The success log (`✅ … → …`) prints after `moved || marked` — a rejected transition whose marker also failed throws inside `moveToStatusOrMark` and surfaces as the existing warn.

**Previous attempt**: none — first implementation of #910 (builds on #907, fixed by PR #914: `moveToStatusOrMark` sweeps every stale `stage_*` label, so call sites can omit `previousStageKey`).

**CRAP ratchet**: no function's CRAP complexity increases; new helpers stay linear, migrations replace a call, not add branches.

**Test harness note**: `js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js` (the degraded node mirror of the GraalJS `testRunner.js`) lacked the `makeDefaultConfigLoaderMock`/`makeDefaultJiraConfig` suite globals; they are mirrored from `testRunner.js` so the recover*/check* suites run under the node harness too.

{"content":"### Root Cause

On restricted workflows (ADO Test Case / ADO PBI), the test-automation statuses (`Passed`, `Failed`, `In Review - Passed/Failed`, `Skipped`, `Irrelevant`, `Bug To Fix`, `In Testing`, `Ready For Testing`, `Merged`) are tag-only. ~25 modules moved tickets with raw `tracker.moveToStatus(...)`, so ADO rejected the transition and the call sites swallowed the error — no status change, no `stage_*` marker, and `✅ Moved …` logs that lied. The shipped SM rules made it worse: their JQL gated on the same statuses, so tickets carrying only a `stage_*` marker were invisible, and `smAgent`'s `rule.targetStatus` move (Merged → Ready For Testing) hit the same raw call.

### Fix

- `js/common/trackers.js`: added `hasStage(ticket, stageKey, statusName)` — status match, or (label mode only) the `stage_<key>` marker; no label reads in the default `'none'` mode.
- Migrated every test-automation mover to `moveToStatusOrMark(key, STATUS, STAGE_KEY)` (`moveToInTesting`, `moveToReadyForTesting`, `post*Results`, `mergeStoryTestAutomationPR`, `retryMergePR`, `prepareTestPRForReview`, `check*Passed`, `checkBugToFixReady`, `checkTaskStoriesDone`, `finishTestCasesGeneration`, `storyTestAutomationRework`, `triggerBitriseTestAutomation`, `recover*`, `postBugCreation`, `postBulkBugsCreation`, `createBugFixBatchEpic`); dev-flow statuses (Done, Blocked, In Rework, In Review, Backlog, …) stay direct moves.
- Status-equality gates in the check/merge/PR modules now resolve through `hasStage(...)`.
- `sm.json` (≡ `agents/sm.json`), `agents/sm_merge.json`, `agents/bulk_bugs_creation.json`: tag-only-status gates switched to whole-clause `{stage.X:Literal}` placeholders; in `'none'` mode single-status rules expand byte-identical, two-status rules to the equivalent `status in ('A') OR status in ('B')`.
- `js/smAgent.js`: `rule.targetStatus` resolves against the tag-only stage set and falls back to `moveToStatusOrMark`; `js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js` mirrors `testRunner.js`'s `makeDefaultConfigLoaderMock` helpers.

Opt-in via the existing `jira.stageFallback: 'label'` / `customParams.stageFallback`; default `'none'` keeps today's behaviour.

### Test Coverage

- Reproduction tests per flow: rejected transitions in `'label'` mode now mark `stage_*` and the flow completes (e.g. `test_moveToInTesting`, `test_mergeStoryTestAutomationPR`, `test_retryMergePR`, `test_recoverMergedPRTicket`, `test_smAgent` targetStatus suites); `'none'`-mode tests pin the unchanged path.
- Full suite: 136 files from `run_all.json` — result recorded below.

### Notes

- `agents/` here is a self-symlink (consumer-layout shim, gitignored) — `sm.json` and `agents/sm.json` are one file.
- Two-status `{stage.*}` rules expand to two OR-ed clauses instead of one two-value `status in (...)` — same selection, different bytes, in `'none'` mode too.
- One pre-existing node-harness failure in `test_smAgent.js` (`assert.doesNotThrow` exists only in the GraalJS runner) is unrelated.

The `{stage.*}` expansion emits a FULL clause `status in ('Merged')` — nested inside the template's quotes → broken: `status in ('status in ('Merged')`.

CRITICAL: I must rewrite each migrated rule's jql so the stage placeholder REPLACES the whole `status in (...)` clause, not sit inside quotes. My sed only renamed `{status.` → `{stage.` leaving `status in ('{stage.MERGED:Merged}')`.

Check all 17 rules' shapes: most are `status in ('{stage.X:Lit}', '{stage.Y:Lit}')` — ALL broken this way. The PO_REVIEW rule (pre-existing) is `AND {stage.PO_REVIEW:PO Review}` — whole-clause form (that's why its assertion passed).

Fix: transform every `status in ('{stage.X:Lit}'(, '{stage.Y:Lit}')*)` → `{stage.X:Lit}( OR {stage.Y:Lit})`? NO — careful: a single `{stage.X:Lit}` expands to `(status in ('X') OR labels = 'stage_x')`. TWO placeholders need ONE status-in + ONE labels OR-combined: `(status in ('X','Y') OR labels = 'stage_x' OR labels = 'stage_y')` — but the current machinery can't express that from two placeholders: `{stage.X} OR {stage.Y}` → `(status in ('X') OR labels='stage_x') OR (status in ('Y') OR labels='stage_y')` — semantically EQUIVALENT selection (union of both clauses; OR is associative). Double-nested parens fine for JQL/WIQL.

So transformation per jql:
- `status in ('{stage.A:L1}')` → `{stage.A:L1}`
- `status in ('{stage.A:L1}', '{stage.B:L2}')` → `({stage.A:L1} OR {stage.B:L2})`
- bulk_bugs_creation: already whole-clause (`AND {stage.FAILED:Failed}`) ✓ (I did that one correctly).

Note: `status not in (...)` forms — check none of the stage rules use `not in`. From the earlier grep, stage rules are all `status in (...)`. The `status not in ({status.DONE:Done})` line 40 stays status-form ✓.

Also WIQL/jqlByTracker? None.

sed transformation: handle the 1-placeholder and 2-placeholder cases:
`s/status in ('{stage.\([A-Z_]*\):\([^)]*\)}')/{stage.\1:\2}/g` — handles single and both occurrences inside a 2-list? For the 2-placeholder form: `status in ('{stage.A:L1}', '{stage.B:L2}')` — first the inner pattern `'{stage.A:L1}'` and `'{stage.B:L2}'` each become `{stage.A:L1}` and `{stage.B:L2}`, yielding `status in ({stage.A:L1}, {stage.B:L2})`. That's not the OR form I designed — `status in (` remains!

Better: replace the full `status in ('{stage.A:L1}', '{stage.B:L2}')` → `({stage.A:L1} OR {stage.B:L2})` first, then the single form.

sed:
1. `s/status in ('{stage\.\([A-Z0-9_]*\):\([^}]*\)}', '{stage\.\([A-Z0-9_]*\):\([^}]*\)}')/({stage.\1:\2} OR {stage.\3:\4})/g`
2. `s/status in ('{stage\.\([A-Z0-9_]*\):\([^}]*\)}')/{stage.\1:\2}/g`

Literals contain spaces/dashes but not `}`. Apply to sm.json + agents/sm_merge.json (sm.json==agents/sm.json via symlink; careful — earlier sed on 'sm.json agents/sm.json agents/sm_merge.json agents/bulk_bugs_creation.json' — with symlink, agents/sm.json IS sm.json; sed applied twice to same file — idempotent (no double replacement since pattern no longer matches). OK.

Then re-verify expansion output: single → `status in ('Merged')` none-mode (byte-identical to old ✓); double → `(status in ('In Review - Passed') OR labels = 'stage_in_review_passed') OR (status in ('In Review - Failed') OR labels = 'stage_in_review_failed')` none-mode. Old none-mode was `status in ('In Review - Passed', 'In Review - Failed')` — semantically identical but bytes differ. Acceptable? The interpolation contract says 'none' mode = "the plain status clause the rule always had". Byte-difference is a query-behavior-preserving change; tests pin byte-equality only for PO_REVIEW and MERGED singles. Fine — but let me note it in RCA/response.

Actually — could keep double-placeholder rules byte-identical by extending interpolateStagePlaceholders to merge? Over-engineering; skip. Semantic equivalence is verified by expansion test below.
My sed left the stage placeholders inside the old `status in ('…')` quotes — broken nesting. Rewrite the clauses to whole-clause form:

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On trackers whose workflow lacks the Jira-style statuses used by the test-automation pipeline (ADO Test Case: `Design`/`Ready`/`Closed`; ADO PBI/Bug: `New`…`Done`), every test-automation status "move" to a tag-only status (`PASSED`, `FAILED`, `IN_REVIEW_PASSED`, `IN_REVIEW_FAILED`, `SKIPPED`, `IRRELEVANT`, `BUG_TO_FIX`, `IN_TESTING`, `READY_FOR_TESTING`, `MERGED`) silently no-ops, and downstream status gates/queries never match.

**Root cause**: ~25 modules in `js/` call the tracker's raw `moveToStatus(key, STATUS)` (instead of the safe `moveToStatusOrMark(key, STATUS, stageKey)` introduced in agents#855/#856, PR #914) with status values that are not real states on restricted workflows. ADO rejects the transition; most call sites catch the error, `console.warn`, and continue — so the ticket's real state never changes, no `stage_<key>` label is recorded, and the `✅ Moved …` success logs lie. The same gap exists on the query side: shipped SM rules (`sm.json`, `agents/sm_merge.json`, `agents/bulk_bugs_creation.json`) gated their JQL on `{status.<TAG_ONLY>:Literal}` — in label mode a ticket carrying only the `stage_*` marker can never match — and `smAgent.moveStatus` moved `rule.targetStatus` (sm.json moves Merged → `Ready For Testing`) through the same raw `moveToStatus`. Status-equality gates (`checkStoryTestsPassed.js`, `checkBugTestsPassed.js`, `retryMergePR.js`, `prepareTestPRForReview.js:resolveFinalStatus`, `mergeStoryTestAutomationPR.js:resolveFinalStatus`) and WIQL/JQL filters built from the same statuses (`createBugFixBatchEpic.js` `bugStillRelevant`) can then never match, stalling the whole chain (`bug_fix_batch_coordinator` finds "no relevant bugs" forever).

**Impact**: Test-automation / merge / rework SM flows on restricted-workflow trackers (ADO Test Case, ADO PBI) silently stall or repeat; `bug_fix_batch_coordinator` never batches any bug. On Jira/GitHub deployments and in default `stageFallback: 'none'` mode nothing changes — the gap only bites where the workflow does not contain those statuses.

**Fix approach** (backward compatible, opt-in via the existing `jira.stageFallback: 'label'` / `customParams.stageFallback` switch):
1. Add `tracker.hasStage(ticket, stageKey, statusName)` to `js/common/trackers.js`: true when `ticket.status === statusName` or (label mode only) the ticket carries `stageLabel(stageKey)`. No label reads, no behaviour change in `'none'` mode.
2. Replace direct `moveToStatus(key, STATUS)` with `moveToStatusOrMark(key, STATUS, '<STAGE_KEY>')` (no `previousStageKey` — PR #914 sweeps stale labels) at every test-automation call site whose target status can be tag-only: the per-stage movers (`moveToInTesting`, `moveToReadyForTesting`), result posters (`postStoryTestAutomationResults`, `postTestAutomationResults`, `postMobileTestAutomationResults`, `postTestReworkResults`, `postBugCreation`, `postBulkBugsCreation`), merge/review flow (`mergeStoryTestAutomationPR`, `retryMergePR`, `prepareTestPRForReview`, `checkStoryTestsPassed`, `checkBugTestsPassed`, `checkBugToFixReady`, `checkTaskStoriesDone`, `finishTestCasesGeneration`, `storyTestAutomationRework`, `triggerBitriseTestAutomation`), recovery movers (`recoverFailedTCBugStatus`, `recoverMergedPRTicket`, `recoverStuckTestCase`) and `createBugFixBatchEpic`. Moves to statuses that exist everywhere (`DONE`, `BLOCKED`, `IN_REWORK`, `READY_FOR_DEVELOPMENT`, `IN_REVIEW`, `BACKLOG`, …) stay direct. Existing `try/catch` blocks stay — `moveToStatusOrMark` only changes the outcome in label mode.
3. Status-equality gates in `checkStoryTestsPassed`, `checkBugTestsPassed`, `retryMergePR`, `prepareTestPRForReview`, `mergeStoryTestAutomationPR` go through `hasStage(...)`.
4. Query gates: `createBugFixBatchEpic.js` builds its Test-Case relevance WIQL/JQL through `configLoader.interpolateStagePlaceholders` (`{stage.FAILED:…}` / `{stage.BUG_TO_FIX:…}`); the shipped SM rule templates (`sm.json` ≡ `agents/sm.json`, `agents/sm_merge.json`, `agents/bulk_bugs_creation.json`) switch their tag-only-status gates from `{status.X:Lit}` to whole-clause `{stage.X:Lit}` forms. In `'none'` mode single-placeholder rules produce the byte-identical clause; two-status rules become the semantically equal `status in ('A') OR status in ('B')` (the stage machinery cannot emit a two-value `in` — accepted, behaviour-preserving).
5. `smAgent.moveStatus` resolves `rule.targetStatus` against the configured statuses restricted to the tag-only stage set and calls `moveToStatusOrMark`; unconfigured/dev-flow targets keep the plain move. The success log (`✅ … → …`) prints after `moved || marked` — a rejected transition whose marker also failed throws inside `moveToStatusOrMark` and surfaces as the existing warn.

**Previous attempt**: none — first implementation of #910 (builds on #907, fixed by PR #914: `moveToStatusOrMark` sweeps every stale `stage_*` label, so call sites can omit `previousStageKey`).

**CRAP ratchet**: no function's CRAP complexity increases; new helpers stay linear, migrations replace a call, not add branches.

**Test harness note**: `js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js` (the degraded node mirror of the GraalJS `testRunner.js`) lacked the `makeDefaultConfigLoaderMock`/`makeDefaultJiraConfig` suite globals; they are mirrored from `testRunner.js` so the recover*/check* suites run under the node harness too.
"}

{"content":"### Root Cause

On restricted workflows (ADO Test Case / ADO PBI), the test-automation statuses (`Passed`, `Failed`, `In Review - Passed/Failed`, `Skipped`, `Irrelevant`, `Bug To Fix`, `In Testing`, `Ready For Testing`, `Merged`) are tag-only. ~25 modules moved tickets with raw `tracker.moveToStatus(...)`, so ADO rejected the transition and the call sites swallowed the error — no status change, no `stage_*` marker, and `✅ Moved …` logs that lied. The shipped SM rules made it worse: their JQL gated on the same statuses, so tickets carrying only a `stage_*` marker were invisible, and `smAgent`'s `rule.targetStatus` move (Merged → Ready For Testing) hit the same raw call.

### Fix

- `js/common/trackers.js`: added `hasStage(ticket, stageKey, statusName)` — status match, or (label mode only) the `stage_<key>` marker; no label reads in the default `'none'` mode.
- Migrated every test-automation mover to `moveToStatusOrMark(key, STATUS, STAGE_KEY)` (`moveToInTesting`, `moveToReadyForTesting`, `post*Results`, `mergeStoryTestAutomationPR`, `retryMergePR`, `prepareTestPRForReview`, `check*Passed`, `checkBugToFixReady`, `checkTaskStoriesDone`, `finishTestCasesGeneration`, `storyTestAutomationRework`, `triggerBitriseTestAutomation`, `recover*`, `postBugCreation`, `postBulkBugsCreation`, `createBugFixBatchEpic`); dev-flow statuses (Done, Blocked, In Rework, In Review, Backlog, …) stay direct moves.
- Status-equality gates in the check/merge/PR modules now resolve through `hasStage(...)`.
- `sm.json` (≡ `agents/sm.json`), `agents/sm_merge.json`, `agents/bulk_bugs_creation.json`: tag-only-status gates switched to whole-clause `{stage.X:Literal}` placeholders; in `'none'` mode single-status rules expand byte-identical, two-status rules to the equivalent `status in ('A') OR status in ('B')`.
- `js/smAgent.js`: `rule.targetStatus` resolves against the tag-only stage set and falls back to `moveToStatusOrMark`; `js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js` mirrors `testRunner.js`'s `makeDefaultConfigLoaderMock` helpers.

Opt-in via the existing `jira.stageFallback: 'label'` / `customParams.stageFallback`; default `'none'` keeps today's behaviour.

### Test Coverage

- Reproduction tests per flow: rejected transitions in `'label'` mode now mark `stage_*` and the flow completes (e.g. `test_moveToInTesting`, `test_mergeStoryTestAutomationPR`, `test_retryMergePR`, `test_recoverMergedPRTicket`, `test_smAgent` targetStatus suites); `'none'`-mode tests pin the unchanged path.
- Full suite: 136 files from `run_all.json` — result recorded below.

### Notes

- `agents/` here is a self-symlink (consumer-layout shim, gitignored) — `sm.json` and `agents/sm.json` are one file.
- Two-status `{stage.*}` rules expand to two OR-ed clauses instead of one two-value `status in (...)` — same selection, different bytes, in `'none'` mode too.
- One pre-existing node-harness failure in `test_smAgent.js` (`assert.doesNotThrow` exists only in the GraalJS runner) is unrelated.

blocks.text:
The `test_cases_generator.json` rule's jql is `status in ('{stage.MERGED:Merged}')` — QUOTED form (my sed replaced only the placeholder inside the existing quotes, not the surrounding clause). The `{stage.*}` expansion emits a FULL clause `status in ('Merged')` — nested inside the template's quotes → broken: `status in ('status in ('Merged')`.

CRITICAL: I must rewrite each migrated rule's jql so the stage placeholder REPLACES the whole `status in (...)` clause, not sit inside quotes. My sed only renamed `{status.` → `{stage.` leaving `status in ('{stage.MERGED:Merged}')`.

Check all 17 rules' shapes: most are `status in ('{stage.X:Lit}', '{stage.Y:Lit}')` — ALL broken this way. The PO_REVIEW rule (pre-existing) is `AND {stage.PO_REVIEW:PO Review}` — whole-clause form (that's why its assertion passed).

Fix: transform every `status in ('{stage.X:Lit}'(, '{stage.Y:Lit}')*)` → `{stage.X:Lit}( OR {stage.Y:Lit})`? NO — careful: a single `{stage.X:Lit}` expands to `(status in ('X') OR labels = 'stage_x')`. TWO placeholders need ONE status-in + ONE labels OR-combined: `(status in ('X','Y') OR labels = 'stage_x' OR labels = 'stage_y')` — but the current machinery can't express that from two placeholders: `{stage.X} OR {stage.Y}` → `(status in ('X') OR labels='stage_x') OR (status in ('Y') OR labels='stage_y')` — semantically EQUIVALENT selection (union of both clauses; OR is associative). Double-nested parens fine for JQL/WIQL.

So transformation per jql:
- `status in ('{stage.A:L1}')` → `{stage.A:L1}`
- `status in ('{stage.A:L1}', '{stage.B:L2}')` → `({stage.A:L1} OR {stage.B:L2})`
- bulk_bugs_creation: already whole-clause (`AND {stage.FAILED:Failed}`) ✓ (I did that one correctly).

Note: `status not in (...)` forms — check none of the stage rules use `not in`. From the earlier grep, stage rules are all `status in (...)`. The `status not in ({status.DONE:Done})` line 40 stays status-form ✓.

Also WIQL/jqlByTracker? None.

sed transformation: handle the 1-placeholder and 2-placeholder cases:
`s/status in ('{stage.\([A-Z_]*\):\([^)]*\)}')/{stage.\1:\2}/g` — handles single and both occurrences inside a 2-list? For the 2-placeholder form: `status in ('{stage.A:L1}', '{stage.B:L2}')` — first the inner pattern `'{stage.A:L1}'` and `'{stage.B:L2}'` each become `{stage.A:L1}` and `{stage.B:L2}`, yielding `status in ({stage.A:L1}, {stage.B:L2})`. That's not the OR form I designed — `status in (` remains!

Better: replace the full `status in ('{stage.A:L1}', '{stage.B:L2}')` → `({stage.A:L1} OR {stage.B:L2})` first, then the single form.

1. `s/status in ('{stage\.\([A-Z0-9_]*\):\([^}]*\)}', '{stage\.\([A-Z0-9_]*\):\([^}]*\)}')/({stage.\1:\2} OR {stage.\3:\4})/g`

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On trackers whose workflow lacks the Jira-style statuses used by the test-automation pipeline (ADO Test Case: `Design`/`Ready`/`Closed`; ADO PBI/Bug: `New`…`Done`), every test-automation status "move" to a tag-only status (`PASSED`, `FAILED`, `IN_REVIEW_PASSED`, `IN_REVIEW_FAILED`, `SKIPPED`, `IRRELEVANT`, `BUG_TO_FIX`, `IN_TESTING`, `READY_FOR_TESTING`, `MERGED`) silently no-ops, and downstream status gates/queries never match.

**Root cause**: ~25 modules in `js/` call the tracker's raw `moveToStatus(key, STATUS)` (instead of the safe `moveToStatusOrMark(key, STATUS, stageKey)` introduced in agents#855/#856, PR #914) with status values that are not real states on restricted workflows. ADO rejects the transition; most call sites catch the error, `console.warn`, and continue — so the ticket's real state never changes, no `stage_<key>` label is recorded, and the `✅ Moved …` success logs lie. The same gap exists on the query side: shipped SM rules (`sm.json`, `agents/sm_merge.json`, `agents/bulk_bugs_creation.json`) gated their JQL on `{status.<TAG_ONLY>:Literal}` — in label mode a ticket carrying only the `stage_*` marker can never match — and `smAgent.moveStatus` moved `rule.targetStatus` (sm.json moves Merged → `Ready For Testing`) through the same raw `moveToStatus`. Status-equality gates (`checkStoryTestsPassed.js`, `checkBugTestsPassed.js`, `retryMergePR.js`, `prepareTestPRForReview.js:resolveFinalStatus`, `mergeStoryTestAutomationPR.js:resolveFinalStatus`) and WIQL/JQL filters built from the same statuses (`createBugFixBatchEpic.js` `bugStillRelevant`) can then never match, stalling the whole chain (`bug_fix_batch_coordinator` finds "no relevant bugs" forever).

**Impact**: Test-automation / merge / rework SM flows on restricted-workflow trackers (ADO Test Case, ADO PBI) silently stall or repeat; `bug_fix_batch_coordinator` never batches any bug. On Jira/GitHub deployments and in default `stageFallback: 'none'` mode nothing changes — the gap only bites where the workflow does not contain those statuses.

**Fix approach** (backward compatible, opt-in via the existing `jira.stageFallback: 'label'` / `customParams.stageFallback` switch):
1. Add `tracker.hasStage(ticket, stageKey, statusName)` to `js/common/trackers.js`: true when `ticket.status === statusName` or (label mode only) the ticket carries `stageLabel(stageKey)`. No label reads, no behaviour change in `'none'` mode.
2. {"content":"### Root Cause

On restricted workflows (ADO Test Case / ADO PBI), the test-automation statuses (`Passed`, `Failed`, `In Review - Passed/Failed`, `Skipped`, `Irrelevant`, `Bug To Fix`, `In Testing`, `Ready For Testing`, `Merged`) are tag-only. ~25 modules moved tickets with raw `tracker.moveToStatus(...)`, so ADO rejected the transition and the call sites swallowed the error — no status change, no `stage_*` marker, and `✅ Moved …` logs that lied. The shipped SM rules made it worse: their JQL gated on the same statuses, so tickets carrying only a `stage_*` marker were invisible, and `smAgent`'s `rule.targetStatus` move (Merged → Ready For Testing) hit the same raw call.

### Fix

- `js/common/trackers.js`: added `hasStage(ticket, stageKey, statusName)` — status match, or (label mode only) the `stage_<key>` marker; no label reads in the default `'none'` mode.
- Migrated every test-automation mover to `moveToStatusOrMark(key, STATUS, STAGE_KEY)` (`moveToInTesting`, `moveToReadyForTesting`, `post*Results`, `mergeStoryTestAutomationPR`, `retryMergePR`, `prepareTestPRForReview`, `check*Passed`, `checkBugToFixReady`, `checkTaskStoriesDone`, `finishTestCasesGeneration`, `storyTestAutomationRework`, `triggerBitriseTestAutomation`, `recover*`, `postBugCreation`, `postBulkBugsCreation`, `createBugFixBatchEpic`); dev-flow statuses (Done, Blocked, In Rework, In Review, Backlog, …) stay direct moves.
- Status-equality gates in the check/merge/PR modules now resolve through `hasStage(...)`.
- `sm.json` (≡ `agents/sm.json`), `agents/sm_merge.json`, `agents/bulk_bugs_creation.json`: tag-only-status gates switched to whole-clause `{stage.X:Literal}` placeholders; in `'none'` mode single-status rules expand byte-identical, two-status rules to the equivalent `status in ('A') OR status in ('B')`.
- `js/smAgent.js`: `rule.targetStatus` resolves against the tag-only stage set and falls back to `moveToStatusOrMark`; `js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js` mirrors `testRunner.js`'s `makeDefaultConfigLoaderMock` helpers.

Opt-in via the existing `jira.stageFallback: 'label'` / `customParams.stageFallback`; default `'none'` keeps today's behaviour.

### Test Coverage

- Reproduction tests per flow: rejected transitions in `'label'` mode now mark `stage_*` and the flow completes (e.g. `test_moveToInTesting`, `test_mergeStoryTestAutomationPR`, `test_retryMergePR`, `test_recoverMergedPRTicket`, `test_smAgent` targetStatus suites); `'none'`-mode tests pin the unchanged path.
- Full suite: 136 files from `run_all.json` — result recorded below.

### Notes

- `agents/` here is a self-symlink (consumer-layout shim, gitignored) — `sm.json` and `agents/sm.json` are one file.
- Two-status `{stage.*}` rules expand to two OR-ed clauses instead of one two-value `status in (...)` — same selection, different bytes, in `'none'` mode too.
- One pre-existing node-harness failure in `test_smAgent.js` (`assert.doesNotThrow` exists only in the GraalJS runner) is unrelated.

blocks.text:
The `test_cases_generator.json` rule's jql is `status in ('{stage.MERGED:Merged}')` — QUOTED form (my sed replaced only the placeholder inside the existing quotes, not the surrounding clause). The `{stage.*}` expansion emits a FULL clause `status in ('Merged')` — nested inside the template's quotes → broken: `status in ('status in ('Merged')`.

CRITICAL: I must rewrite each migrated rule's jql so the stage placeholder REPLACES the whole `status in (...)` clause, not sit inside quotes. My sed only renamed `{status.` → `{stage.` leaving `status in ('{stage.MERGED:Merged}')`.

Check all 17 rules' shapes: most are `status in ('{stage.X:Lit}', '{stage.Y:Lit}')` — ALL broken this way. The PO_REVIEW rule (pre-existing) is `AND {stage.PO_REVIEW:PO Review}` — whole-clause form (that's why its assertion passed).

Fix: transform every `status in ('{stage.X:Lit}'(, '{stage.Y:Lit}')*)` → `{stage.X:Lit}( OR {stage.Y:Lit})`? NO — careful: a single `{stage.X:Lit}` expands to `(status in ('X') OR labels = 'stage_x')`. TWO placeholders need ONE status-in + ONE labels OR-combined: `(status in ('X','Y') OR labels = 'stage_x' OR labels = 'stage_y')` — but the current machinery can't express that from two placeholders: `{stage.X} OR {stage.Y}` → `(status in ('X') OR labels='stage_x') OR (status in ('Y') OR labels='stage_y')` — semantically EQUIVALENT selection (union of both clauses; OR is associative). Double-nested parens fine for JQL/WIQL.

So transformation per jql:
- `status in ('{stage.A:L1}')` → `{stage.A:L1}`
- `status in ('{stage.A:L1}', '{stage.B:L2}')` → `({stage.A:L1} OR {stage.B:L2})`
- bulk_bugs_creation: already whole-clause (`AND {stage.FAILED:Failed}`) ✓ (I did that one correctly).

Note: `status not in (...)` forms — check none of the stage rules use `not in`. From the earlier grep, stage rules are all `status in (...)`. The `status not in ({status.DONE:Done})` line 40 stays status-form ✓.

Also WIQL/jqlByTracker? None.

sed transformation: handle the 1-placeholder and 2-placeholder cases:
`s/status in ('{stage.\([A-Z_]*\):\([^)]*\)}')/{stage.\1:\2}/g` — handles single and both occurrences inside a 2-list? For the 2-placeholder form: `status in ('{stage.A:L1}', '{stage.B:L2}')` — first the inner pattern `'{stage.A:L1}'` and `'{stage.B:L2}'` each become `{stage.A:L1}` and `{stage.B:L2}`, yielding `status in ({stage.A:L1}, {stage.B:L2})`. That's not the OR form I designed — `status in (` remains!

Better: replace the full `status in ('{stage.A:L1}', '{stage.B:L2}')` → `({stage.A:L1} OR {stage.B:L2})` first, then the single form.

sed:
1. `s/status in ('{stage\.\([A-Z0-9_]*\):\([^}]*\)}', '{stage\.\([A-Z0-9_]*\):\([^}]*\)}')/({stage.\1:\2} OR {stage.\3:\4})/g`
2. `s/status in ('{stage\.\([A-Z0-9_]*\):\([^}]*\)}')/{stage.\1:\2}/g`

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On trackers whose workflow lacks the Jira-style statuses used by the test-automation pipeline (ADO Test Case: `Design`/`Ready`/`Closed`; ADO PBI/Bug: `New`…`Done`), every test-automation status "move" to a tag-only status (`PASSED`, `FAILED`, `IN_REVIEW_PASSED`, `IN_REVIEW_FAILED`, `SKIPPED`, `IRRELEVANT`, `BUG_TO_FIX`, `IN_TESTING`, `READY_FOR_TESTING`, `MERGED`) silently no-ops, and downstream status gates/queries never match.

**Root cause**: ~25 modules in `js/` call the tracker's raw `moveToStatus(key, STATUS)` (instead of the safe `moveToStatusOrMark(key, STATUS, stageKey)` introduced in agents#855/#856, PR #914) with status values that are not real states on restricted workflows. ADO rejects the transition; most call sites catch the error, `console.warn`, and continue — so the ticket's real state never changes, no `stage_<key>` label is recorded, and the `✅ Moved …` success logs lie. The same gap exists on the query side: shipped SM rules (`sm.json`, `agents/sm_merge.json`, `agents/bulk_bugs_creation.json`) gated their JQL on `{status.<TAG_ONLY>:Literal}` — in label mode a ticket carrying only the `stage_*` marker can never match — and `smAgent.moveStatus` moved `rule.targetStatus` (sm.json moves Merged → `Ready For Testing`) through the same raw `moveToStatus`. Status-equality gates (`checkStoryTestsPassed.js`, `checkBugTestsPassed.js`, `retryMergePR.js`, `prepareTestPRForReview.js:resolveFinalStatus`, `mergeStoryTestAutomationPR.js:resolveFinalStatus`) and WIQL/JQL filters built from the same statuses (`createBugFixBatchEpic.js` `bugStillRelevant`) can then never match, stalling the whole chain (`bug_fix_batch_coordinator` finds "no relevant bugs" forever).

**Impact**: Test-automation / merge / rework SM flows on restricted-workflow trackers (ADO Test Case, ADO PBI) silently stall or repeat; `bug_fix_batch_coordinator` never batches any bug. On Jira/GitHub deployments and in default `stageFallback: 'none'` mode nothing changes — the gap only bites where the workflow does not contain those statuses.

**Fix approach** (backward compatible, opt-in via the existing `jira.stageFallback: 'label'` / `customParams.stageFallback` switch):
1. Add `tracker.hasStage(ticket, stageKey, statusName)` to `js/common/trackers.js`: true when `ticket.status === statusName` or (label mode only) the ticket carries `stageLabel(stageKey)`. No label reads, no behaviour change in `'none'` mode.
2. {"content":"### Root Cause

On restricted workflows (ADO Test Case / ADO PBI), the test-automation statuses (`Passed`, `Failed`, `In Review - Passed/Failed`, `Skipped`, `Irrelevant`, `Bug To Fix`, `In Testing`, `Ready For Testing`, `Merged`) are tag-only. ~25 modules moved tickets with raw `tracker.moveToStatus(...)`, so ADO rejected the transition and the call sites swallowed the error — no status change, no `stage_*` marker, and `✅ Moved …` logs that lied. The shipped SM rules made it worse: their JQL gated on the same statuses, so tickets carrying only a `stage_*` marker were invisible, and `smAgent`'s `rule.targetStatus` move (Merged → Ready For Testing) hit the same raw call.

### Fix

- `js/common/trackers.js`: added `hasStage(ticket, stageKey, statusName)` — status match, or (label mode only) the `stage_<key>` marker; no label reads in the default `'none'` mode.
- Migrated every test-automation mover to `moveToStatusOrMark(key, STATUS, STAGE_KEY)` (`moveToInTesting`, `moveToReadyForTesting`, `post*Results`, `mergeStoryTestAutomationPR`, `retryMergePR`, `prepareTestPRForReview`, `check*Passed`, `checkBugToFixReady`, `checkTaskStoriesDone`, `finishTestCasesGeneration`, `storyTestAutomationRework`, `triggerBitriseTestAutomation`, `recover*`, `postBugCreation`, `postBulkBugsCreation`, `createBugFixBatchEpic`); dev-flow statuses (Done, Blocked, In Rework, In Review, Backlog, …) stay direct moves.
- Status-equality gates in the check/merge/PR modules now resolve through `hasStage(...)`.
- `sm.json` (≡ `agents/sm.json`), `agents/sm_merge.json`, `agents/bulk_bugs_creation.json`: tag-only-status gates switched to whole-clause `{stage.X:Literal}` placeholders; in `'none'` mode single-status rules expand byte-identical, two-status rules to the equivalent `status in ('A') OR status in ('B')`.
- `js/smAgent.js`: `rule.targetStatus` resolves against the tag-only stage set and falls back to `moveToStatusOrMark`; `js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js` mirrors `testRunner.js`'s `makeDefaultConfigLoaderMock` helpers.

Opt-in via the existing `jira.stageFallback: 'label'` / `customParams.stageFallback`; default `'none'` keeps today's behaviour.

### Test Coverage

- Reproduction tests per flow: rejected transitions in `'label'` mode now mark `stage_*` and the flow completes (e.g. `test_moveToInTesting`, `test_mergeStoryTestAutomationPR`, `test_retryMergePR`, `test_recoverMergedPRTicket`, `test_smAgent` targetStatus suites); `'none'`-mode tests pin the unchanged path.
- Full suite: 136 files from `run_all.json` — result recorded below.

### Notes

- `agents/` here is a self-symlink (consumer-layout shim, gitignored) — `sm.json` and `agents/sm.json` are one file.
- Two-status `{stage.*}` rules expand to two OR-ed clauses instead of one two-value `status in (...)` — same selection, different bytes, in `'none'` mode too.
- One pre-existing node-harness failure in `test_smAgent.js` (`assert.doesNotThrow` exists only in the GraalJS runner) is unrelated.

blocks.text:
The `test_cases_generator.json` rule's jql is `status in ('{stage.MERGED:Merged}')` — QUOTED form (my sed replaced only the placeholder inside the existing quotes, not the surrounding clause). The `{stage.*}` expansion emits a FULL clause `status in ('Merged')` — nested inside the template's quotes → broken: `status in ('status in ('Merged')`.

CRITICAL: I must rewrite each migrated rule's jql so the stage placeholder REPLACES the whole `status in (...)` clause, not sit inside quotes. My sed only renamed `{status.` → `{stage.` leaving `status in ('{stage.MERGED:Merged}')`.

Check all 17 rules' shapes: most are `status in ('{stage.X:Lit}', '{stage.Y:Lit}')` — ALL broken this way. The PO_REVIEW rule (pre-existing) is `AND {stage.PO_REVIEW:PO Review}` — whole-clause form (that's why its assertion passed).

Fix: transform every `status in ('{stage.X:Lit}'(, '{stage.Y:Lit}')*)` → `{stage.X:Lit}( OR {stage.Y:Lit})`? NO — careful: a single `{stage.X:Lit}` expands to `(status in ('X') OR labels = 'stage_x')`. TWO placeholders need ONE status-in + ONE labels OR-combined: `(status in ('X','Y') OR labels = 'stage_x' OR labels = 'stage_y')` — but the current machinery can't express that from two placeholders: `{stage.X} OR {stage.Y}` → `(status in ('X') OR labels='stage_x') OR (status in ('Y') OR labels='stage_y')` — semantically EQUIVALENT selection (union of both clauses; OR is associative). Double-nested parens fine for JQL/WIQL.

So transformation per jql:
- `status in ('{stage.A:L1}')` → `{stage.A:L1}`
- `status in ('{stage.A:L1}', '{stage.B:L2}')` → `({stage.A:L1} OR {stage.B:L2})`
- bulk_bugs_creation: already whole-clause (`AND {stage.FAILED:Failed}`) ✓ (I did that one correctly).

Note: `status not in (...)` forms — check none of the stage rules use `not in`. From the earlier grep, stage rules are all `status in (...)`. The `status not in ({status.DONE:Done})` line 40 stays status-form ✓.

Also WIQL/jqlByTracker? None.

sed transformation: handle the 1-placeholder and 2-placeholder cases:
`s/status in ('{stage.\([A-Z_]*\):\([^)]*\)}')/{stage.\1:\2}/g` — handles single and both occurrences inside a 2-list? For the 2-placeholder form: `status in ('{stage.A:L1}', '{stage.B:L2}')` — first the inner pattern `'{stage.A:L1}'` and `'{stage.B:L2}'` each become `{stage.A:L1}` and `{stage.B:L2}`, yielding `status in ({stage.A:L1}, {stage.B:L2})`. That's not the OR form I designed — `status in (` remains!

Better: replace the full `status in ('{stage.A:L1}', '{stage.B:L2}')` → `({stage.A:L1} OR {stage.B:L2})` first, then the single form.

1. `s/status in ('{stage\.\([A-Z0-9_]*\):\([^}]*\)}', '{stage\.\([A-Z0-9_]*\):\([^}]*\)}')/({stage.\1:\2} OR {stage.\3:\4})/g`

**Bug**: On trackers whose workflow lacks the Jira-style statuses used by the test-automation pipeline (ADO Test Case: `Design`/`Ready`/`Closed`; ADO PBI/Bug: `New`…`Done`), every test-automation status "move" to a tag-only status (`PASSED`, `FAILED`, `IN_REVIEW_PASSED`, `IN_REVIEW_FAILED`, `SKIPPED`, `IRRELEVANT`, `BUG_TO_FIX`, `IN_TESTING`, `READY_FOR_TESTING`, `MERGED`) silently no-ops, and downstream status gates/queries never match.

**Root cause**: ~25 modules in `js/` call the tracker's raw `moveToStatus(key, STATUS)` (instead of the safe `moveToStatusOrMark(key, STATUS, stageKey)` introduced in agents#855/#856, PR #914) with status values that are not real states on restricted workflows. ADO rejects the transition; most call sites catch the error, `console.warn`, and continue — so the ticket's real state never changes, no `stage_<key>` label is recorded, and the `✅ Moved …` success logs lie. The same gap exists on the query side: shipped SM rules (`sm.json`, `agents/sm_merge.json`, `agents/bulk_bugs_creation.json`) gated their JQL on `{status.<TAG_ONLY>:Literal}` — in label mode a ticket carrying only the `stage_*` marker can never match — and `smAgent.moveStatus` moved `rule.targetStatus` (sm.json moves Merged → `Ready For Testing`) through the same raw `moveToStatus`. Status-equality gates (`checkStoryTestsPassed.js`, `checkBugTestsPassed.js`, `retryMergePR.js`, `prepareTestPRForReview.js:resolveFinalStatus`, `mergeStoryTestAutomationPR.js:resolveFinalStatus`) and WIQL/JQL filters built from the same statuses (`createBugFixBatchEpic.js` `bugStillRelevant`) can then never match, stalling the whole chain (`bug_fix_batch_coordinator` finds "no relevant bugs" forever).

**Impact**: Test-automation / merge / rework SM flows on restricted-workflow trackers (ADO Test Case, ADO PBI) silently stall or repeat; `bug_fix_batch_coordinator` never batches any bug. On Jira/GitHub deployments and in default `stageFallback: 'none'` mode nothing changes — the gap only bites where the workflow does not contain those statuses.

**Fix approach** (backward compatible, opt-in via the existing `jira.stageFallback: 'label'` / `customParams.stageFallback` switch):
1. Add `tracker.hasStage(ticket, stageKey, statusName)` to `js/common/trackers.js`: true when `ticket.status === statusName` or (label mode only) the ticket carries `stageLabel(stageKey)`. No label reads, no behaviour change in `'none'` mode.
2. Replace direct `moveToStatus(key, STATUS)` with `moveToStatusOrMark(key, STATUS, '<STAGE_KEY>')` (no `previousStageKey` — PR #914 sweeps stale labels) at every test-automation call site whose target status can be tag-only: the per-stage movers (`moveToInTesting`, `moveToReadyForTesting`), result posters (`postStoryTestAutomationResults`, `postTestAutomationResults`, `postMobileTestAutomationResults`, `postTestReworkResults`, `postBugCreation`, `postBulkBugsCreation`), merge/review flow (`mergeStoryTestAutomationPR`, `retryMergePR`, `prepareTestPRForReview`, `checkStoryTestsPassed`, `checkBugTestsPassed`, `checkBugToFixReady`, `checkTaskStoriesDone`, `finishTestCasesGeneration`, `storyTestAutomationRework`, `triggerBitriseTestAutomation`), recovery movers (`recoverFailedTCBugStatus`, `recoverMergedPRTicket`, `recoverStuckTestCase`) and `createBugFixBatchEpic`. Moves to statuses that exist everywhere (`DONE`, `BLOCKED`, `IN_REWORK`, `READY_FOR_DEVELOPMENT`, `IN_REVIEW`, `BACKLOG`, …) stay direct. Existing `try/catch` blocks stay — `moveToStatusOrMark` only changes the outcome in label mode.
3. Status-equality gates in `checkStoryTestsPassed`, `checkBugTestsPassed`, `retryMergePR`, `prepareTestPRForReview`, `mergeStoryTestAutomationPR` go through `hasStage(...)`.
4. Query gates: `createBugFixBatchEpic.js` builds its Test-Case relevance WIQL/JQL through `configLoader.interpolateStagePlaceholders` (`{stage.FAILED:…}` / `{stage.BUG_TO_FIX:…}`); the shipped SM rule templates (`sm.json` ≡ `agents/sm.json`, `agents/sm_merge.json`, `agents/bulk_bugs_creation.json`) switch their tag-only-status gates from `{status.X:Lit}` to whole-clause `{stage.X:Lit}` forms. In `'none'` mode single-placeholder rules produce the byte-identical clause; two-status rules become the semantically equal `status in ('A') OR status in ('B')` (the stage machinery cannot emit a two-value `in` — accepted, behaviour-preserving).

blocks.text:
The `test_cases_generator.json` rule's jql is `status in ('{stage.MERGED:Merged}')` — QUOTED form (my sed replaced only the placeholder inside the existing quotes, not the surrounding clause). The `{stage.*}` expansion emits a FULL clause `status in ('Merged')` — nested inside the template's quotes → broken: `status in ('status in ('Merged')`.

CRITICAL: I must rewrite each migrated rule's jql so the stage placeholder REPLACES the whole `status in (...)` clause, not sit inside quotes. My sed only renamed `{status.` → `{stage.` leaving `status in ('{stage.MERGED:Merged}')`.

Check all 17 rules' shapes: most are `status in ('{stage.X:Lit}', '{stage.Y:Lit}')` — ALL broken this way. The PO_REVIEW rule (pre-existing) is `AND {stage.PO_REVIEW:PO Review}` — whole-clause form (that's why its assertion passed).

Fix: transform every `status in ('{stage.X:Lit}'(, '{stage.Y:Lit}')*)` → `{stage.X:Lit}( OR {stage.Y:Lit})`? NO — careful: a single `{stage.X:Lit}` expands to `(status in ('X') OR labels = 'stage_x')`. TWO placeholders need ONE status-in + ONE labels OR-combined: `(status in ('X','Y') OR labels = 'stage_x' OR labels = 'stage_y')` — but the current machinery can't express that from two placeholders: `{stage.X} OR {stage.Y}` → `(status in ('X') OR labels='stage_x') OR (status in ('Y') OR labels='stage_y')` — semantically EQUIVALENT selection (union of both clauses; OR is associative). Double-nested parens fine for JQL/WIQL.

So transformation per jql:
- `status in ('{stage.A:L1}')` → `{stage.A:L1}`
- `status in ('{stage.A:L1}', '{stage.B:L2}')` → `({stage.A:L1} OR {stage.B:L2})`
- bulk_bugs_creation: already whole-clause (`AND {stage.FAILED:Failed}`) ✓ (I did that one correctly).

Note: `status not in (...)` forms — check none of the stage rules use `not in`. From the earlier grep, stage rules are all `status in (...)`. The `status not in ({status.DONE:Done})` line 40 stays status-form ✓.

Also WIQL/jqlByTracker? None.

sed transformation: handle the 1-placeholder and 2-placeholder cases:
`s/status in ('{stage.\([A-Z_]*\):\([^)]*\)}')/{stage.\1:\2}/g` — handles single and both occurrences inside a 2-list? For the 2-placeholder form: `status in ('{stage.A:L1}', '{stage.B:L2}')` — first the inner pattern `'{stage.A:L1}'` and `'{stage.B:L2}'` each become `{stage.A:L1}` and `{stage.B:L2}`, yielding `status in ({stage.A:L1}, {stage.B:L2})`. That's not the OR form I designed — `status in (` remains!

Better: replace the full `status in ('{stage.A:L1}', '{stage.B:L2}')` → `({stage.A:L1} OR {stage.B:L2})` first, then the single form.

1. `s/status in ('{stage\.\([A-Z0-9_]*\):\([^}]*\)}', '{stage\.\([A-Z0-9_]*\):\([^}]*\)}')/({stage.\1:\2} OR {stage.\3:\4})/g`

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On trackers whose workflow lacks the Jira-style statuses used by the test-automation pipeline (ADO Test Case: `Design`/`Ready`/`Closed`; ADO PBI/Bug: `New`…`Done`), every test-automation status "move" to a tag-only status (`PASSED`, `FAILED`, `IN_REVIEW_PASSED`, `IN_REVIEW_FAILED`, `SKIPPED`, `IRRELEVANT`, `BUG_TO_FIX`, `IN_TESTING`, `READY_FOR_TESTING`, `MERGED`) silently no-ops, and downstream status gates/queries never match.

**Root cause**: ~25 modules in `js/` call the tracker's raw `moveToStatus(key, STATUS)` (instead of the safe `moveToStatusOrMark(key, STATUS, stageKey)` introduced in agents#855/#856, PR #914) with status values that are not real states on restricted workflows. ADO rejects the transition; most call sites catch the error, `console.warn`, and continue — so the ticket's real state never changes, no `stage_<key>` label is recorded, and the `✅ Moved …` success logs lie. The same gap exists on the query side: shipped SM rules (`sm.json`, `agents/sm_merge.json`, `agents/bulk_bugs_creation.json`) gated their JQL on `{status.<TAG_ONLY>:Literal}` — in label mode a ticket carrying only the `stage_*` marker can never match — and `smAgent.moveStatus` moved `rule.targetStatus` (sm.json moves Merged → `Ready For Testing`) through the same raw `moveToStatus`. Status-equality gates (`checkStoryTestsPassed.js`, `checkBugTestsPassed.js`, `retryMergePR.js`, `prepareTestPRForReview.js:resolveFinalStatus`, `mergeStoryTestAutomationPR.js:resolveFinalStatus`) and WIQL/JQL filters built from the same statuses (`createBugFixBatchEpic.js` `bugStillRelevant`) can then never match, stalling the whole chain (`bug_fix_batch_coordinator` finds "no relevant bugs" forever).

**Impact**: Test-automation / merge / rework SM flows on restricted-workflow trackers (ADO Test Case, ADO PBI) silently stall or repeat; `bug_fix_batch_coordinator` never batches any bug. On Jira/GitHub deployments and in default `stageFallback: 'none'` mode nothing changes — the gap only bites where the workflow does not contain those statuses.

**Fix approach** (backward compatible, opt-in via the existing `jira.stageFallback: 'label'` / `customParams.stageFallback` switch):
1. Add `tracker.hasStage(ticket, stageKey, statusName)` to `js/common/trackers.js`: true when `ticket.status === statusName` or (label mode only) the ticket carries `stageLabel(stageKey)`. No label reads, no behaviour change in `'none'` mode.
2. Replace direct `moveToStatus(key, STATUS)` with `moveToStatusOrMark(key, STATUS, '<STAGE_KEY>')` (no `previousStageKey` — PR #914 sweeps stale labels) at every test-automation call site whose target status can be tag-only: the per-stage movers (`moveToInTesting`, `moveToReadyForTesting`), result posters (`postStoryTestAutomationResults`, `postTestAutomationResults`, `postMobileTestAutomationResults`, `postTestReworkResults`, `postBugCreation`, `postBulkBugsCreation`), merge/review flow (`mergeStoryTestAutomationPR`, `retryMergePR`, `prepareTestPRForReview`, `checkStoryTestsPassed`, `checkBugTestsPassed`, `checkBugToFixReady`, `checkTaskStoriesDone`, `finishTestCasesGeneration`, `storyTestAutomationRework`, `triggerBitriseTestAutomation`), recovery movers (`recoverFailedTCBugStatus`, `recoverMergedPRTicket`, `recoverStuckTestCase`) and `createBugFixBatchEpic`. Moves to statuses that exist everywhere (`DONE`, `BLOCKED`, `IN_REWORK`, `READY_FOR_DEVELOPMENT`, `IN_REVIEW`, `BACKLOG`, …) stay direct. Existing `try/catch` blocks stay — `moveToStatusOrMark` only changes the outcome in label mode.
3. Status-equality gates in `checkStoryTestsPassed`, `checkBugTestsPassed`, `retryMergePR`, `prepareTestPRForReview`, `mergeStoryTestAutomationPR` go through `hasStage(...)`.
4. Query gates: `createBugFixBatchEpic.js` builds its Test-Case relevance WIQL/JQL through `configLoader.interpolateStagePlaceholders` (`{stage.FAILED:…}` / `{stage.BUG_TO_FIX:…}`); the shipped SM rule templates (`sm.json` ≡ `agents/sm.json`, `agents/sm_merge.json`, `agents/bulk_bugs_creation.json`) switch their tag-only-status gates from `{status.X:Lit}` to whole-clause `{stage.X:Lit}` forms. In `'none'` mode single-placeholder rules produce the byte-identical clause; two-status rules become the semantically equal `status in ('A') OR status in ('B')` (the stage machinery cannot emit a two-value `in` — accepted, behaviour-preserving).
5. `smAgent.moveStatus` resolves `rule.targetStatus` against the configured statuses restricted to the tag-only stage set and calls `moveToStatusOrMark`; unconfigured/dev-flow targets keep the plain move. The success log (`✅ … → …`) prints after `moved || marked` — a rejected transition whose marker also failed throws inside `moveToStatusOrMark` and surfaces as the existing warn.

**Previous attempt**: none — first implementation of #910 (builds on #907, fixed by PR #914: `moveToStatusOrMark` sweeps every stale `stage_*` label, so call sites can omit `previousStageKey`).

**CRAP ratchet**: no function's CRAP complexity increases; new helpers stay linear, migrations replace a call, not add branches.

**Test harness note**: `js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js` (the degraded node mirror of the GraalJS `testRunner.js`) lacked the `makeDefaultConfigLoaderMock`/`makeDefaultJiraConfig` suite globals; they are mirrored from `testRunner.js` so the recover*/check* suites run under the node harness too.

{"content":"### Root Cause

On restricted workflows (ADO Test Case / ADO PBI), the test-automation statuses (`Passed`, `Failed`, `In Review - Passed/Failed`, `Skipped`, `Irrelevant`, `Bug To Fix`, `In Testing`, `Ready For Testing`, `Merged`) are tag-only. ~25 modules moved tickets with raw `tracker.moveToStatus(...)`, so ADO rejected the transition and the call sites swallowed the error — no status change, no `stage_*` marker, and `✅ Moved …` logs that lied. The shipped SM rules made it worse: their JQL gated on the same statuses, so tickets carrying only a `stage_*` marker were invisible, and `smAgent`'s `rule.targetStatus` move (Merged → Ready For Testing) hit the same raw call.

### Fix

- `js/common/trackers.js`: added `hasStage(ticket, stageKey, statusName)` — status match, or (label mode only) the `stage_<key>` marker; no label reads in the default `'none'` mode.
- Migrated every test-automation mover to `moveToStatusOrMark(key, STATUS, STAGE_KEY)` (`moveToInTesting`, `moveToReadyForTesting`, `post*Results`, `mergeStoryTestAutomationPR`, `retryMergePR`, `prepareTestPRForReview`, `check*Passed`, `checkBugToFixReady`, `checkTaskStoriesDone`, `finishTestCasesGeneration`, `storyTestAutomationRework`, `triggerBitriseTestAutomation`, `recover*`, `postBugCreation`, `postBulkBugsCreation`, `createBugFixBatchEpic`); dev-flow statuses (Done, Blocked, In Rework, In Review, Backlog, …) stay direct moves.
- Status-equality gates in the check/merge/PR modules now resolve through `hasStage(...)`.
- `sm.json` (≡ `agents/sm.json`), `agents/sm_merge.json`, `agents/bulk_bugs_creation.json`: tag-only-status gates switched to whole-clause `{stage.X:Literal}` placeholders; in `'none'` mode single-status rules expand byte-identical, two-status rules to the equivalent `status in ('A') OR status in ('B')`.
- `js/smAgent.js`: `rule.targetStatus` resolves against the tag-only stage set and falls back to `moveToStatusOrMark`; `js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js` mirrors `testRunner.js`'s `makeDefaultConfigLoaderMock` helpers.

Opt-in via the existing `jira.stageFallback: 'label'` / `customParams.stageFallback`; default `'none'` keeps today's behaviour.

### Test Coverage

- Reproduction tests per flow: rejected transitions in `'label'` mode now mark `stage_*` and the flow completes (e.g. `test_moveToInTesting`, `test_mergeStoryTestAutomationPR`, `test_retryMergePR`, `test_recoverMergedPRTicket`, `test_smAgent` targetStatus suites); `'none'`-mode tests pin the unchanged path.
- Full suite: 136 files from `run_all.json` — result recorded below.

### Notes

- `agents/` here is a self-symlink (consumer-layout shim, gitignored) — `sm.json` and `agents/sm.json` are one file.
- Two-status `{stage.*}` rules expand to two OR-ed clauses instead of one two-value `status in (...)` — same selection, different bytes, in `'none'` mode too.
- One pre-existing node-harness failure in `test_smAgent.js` (`assert.doesNotThrow` exists only in the GraalJS runner) is unrelated.

blocks.text:
The `test_cases_generator.json` rule's jql is `status in ('{stage.MERGED:Merged}')` — QUOTED form (my sed replaced only the placeholder inside the existing quotes, not the surrounding clause). The `{stage.*}` expansion emits a FULL clause `status in ('Merged')` — nested inside the template's quotes → broken: `status in ('status in ('Merged')`.

CRITICAL: I must rewrite each migrated rule's jql so the stage placeholder REPLACES the whole `status in (...)` clause, not sit inside quotes. My sed only renamed `{status.` → `{stage.` leaving `status in ('{stage.MERGED:Merged}')`.

Check all 17 rules' shapes: most are `status in ('{stage.X:Lit}', '{stage.Y:Lit}')` — ALL broken this way. The PO_REVIEW rule (pre-existing) is `AND {stage.PO_REVIEW:PO Review}` — whole-clause form (that's why its assertion passed).

Fix: transform every `status in ('{stage.X:Lit}'(, '{stage.Y:Lit}')*)` → `{stage.X:Lit}( OR {stage.Y:Lit})`? NO — careful: a single `{stage.X:Lit}` expands to `(status in ('X') OR labels = 'stage_x')`. TWO placeholders need ONE status-in + ONE labels OR-combined: `(status in ('X','Y') OR labels = 'stage_x' OR labels = 'stage_y')` — but the current machinery can't express that from two placeholders: `{stage.X} OR {stage.Y}` → `(status in ('X') OR labels='stage_x') OR (status in ('Y') OR labels='stage_y')` — semantically EQUIVALENT selection (union of both clauses; OR is associative). Double-nested parens fine for JQL/WIQL.

So transformation per jql:
- `status in ('{stage.A:L1}')` → `{stage.A:L1}`
- `status in ('{stage.A:L1}', '{stage.B:L2}')` → `({stage.A:L1} OR {stage.B:L2})`

sed transformation: handle the 1-placeholder and 2-placeholder cases:
`s/status in ('{stage.\([A-Z_]*\):\([^)]*\)}')/{stage.\1:\2}/g` — handles single and both occurrences inside a 2-list? That's not the OR form I designed — `status in (` remains!

Better: replace the full `status in ('{stage.A:L1}', '{stage.B:L2}')` → `({stage.A:L1} OR {stage.B:L2})` first, then the single form.

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On trackers whose workflow lacks the Jira-style statuses used by the test-automation pipeline (ADO Test Case: `Design`/`Ready`/`Closed`; ADO PBI/Bug: `New`…`Done`), every test-automation status "move" to a tag-only status (`PASSED`, `FAILED`, `IN_REVIEW_PASSED`, `IN_REVIEW_FAILED`, `SKIPPED`, `IRRELEVANT`, `BUG_TO_FIX`, `IN_TESTING`, `READY_FOR_TESTING`, `MERGED`) silently no-ops, and downstream status gates/queries never match.

**Root cause**: ~25 modules in `js/` call the tracker's raw `moveToStatus(key, STATUS)` (instead of the safe `moveToStatusOrMark(key, STATUS, stageKey)` introduced in agents#855/#856, PR #914) with status values that are not real states on restricted workflows. ADO rejects the transition; most call sites catch the error, `console.warn`, and continue — so the ticket's real state never changes, no `stage_<key>` label is recorded, and the `✅ Moved …` success logs lie. The same gap exists on the query side: shipped SM rules (`sm.json`, `agents/sm_merge.json`, `agents/bulk_bugs_creation.json`) gated their JQL on `{status.<TAG_ONLY>:Literal}` — in label mode a ticket carrying only the `stage_*` marker can never match — and `smAgent.moveStatus` moved `rule.targetStatus` (sm.json moves Merged → `Ready For Testing`) through the same raw `moveToStatus`. Status-equality gates (`checkStoryTestsPassed.js`, `checkBugTestsPassed.js`, `retryMergePR.js`, `prepareTestPRForReview.js:resolveFinalStatus`, `mergeStoryTestAutomationPR.js:resolveFinalStatus`) and WIQL/JQL filters built from the same statuses (`createBugFixBatchEpic.js` `bugStillRelevant`) can then never match, stalling the whole chain (`bug_fix_batch_coordinator` finds "no relevant bugs" forever).

**Impact**: Test-automation / merge / rework SM flows on restricted-workflow trackers (ADO Test Case, ADO PBI) silently stall or repeat; `bug_fix_batch_coordinator` never batches any bug. On Jira/GitHub deployments and in default `stageFallback: 'none'` mode nothing changes — the gap only bites where the workflow does not contain those statuses.

**Fix approach** (backward compatible, opt-in via the existing `jira.stageFallback: 'label'` / `customParams.stageFallback` switch):
1. Add `tracker.hasStage(ticket, stageKey, statusName)` to `js/common/trackers.js`: true when `ticket.status === statusName` or (label mode only) the ticket carries `stageLabel(stageKey)`. No label reads, no behaviour change in `'none'` mode.
2. Replace direct `moveToStatus(key, STATUS)` with `moveToStatusOrMark(key, STATUS, '<STAGE_KEY>')` (no `previousStageKey` — PR #914 sweeps stale labels) at every test-automation call site whose target status can be tag-only: the per-stage movers (`moveToInTesting`, `moveToReadyForTesting`), result posters (`postStoryTestAutomationResults`, `postTestAutomationResults`, `postMobileTestAutomationResults`, `postTestReworkResults`, `postBugCreation`, `postBulkBugsCreation`), merge/review flow (`mergeStoryTestAutomationPR`, `retryMergePR`, `prepareTestPRForReview`, `checkStoryTestsPassed`, `checkBugTestsPassed`, `checkBugToFixReady`, `checkTaskStoriesDone`, `finishTestCasesGeneration`, `storyTestAutomationRework`, `triggerBitriseTestAutomation`), recovery movers (`recoverFailedTCBugStatus`, `recoverMergedPRTicket`, `recoverStuckTestCase`) and `createBugFixBatchEpic`. Moves to statuses that exist everywhere (`DONE`, `BLOCKED`, `IN_REWORK`, `READY_FOR_DEVELOPMENT`, `IN_REVIEW`, `BACKLOG`, …) stay direct. Existing `try/catch` blocks stay — `moveToStatusOrMark` only changes the outcome in label mode.
3. Status-equality gates in `checkStoryTestsPassed`, `checkBugTestsPassed`, `retryMergePR`, `prepareTestPRForReview`, `mergeStoryTestAutomationPR` go through `hasStage(...)`.
4. Query gates: `createBugFixBatchEpic.js` builds its Test-Case relevance WIQL/JQL through `configLoader.interpolateStagePlaceholders` (`{stage.FAILED:…}` / `{stage.BUG_TO_FIX:…}`); the shipped SM rule templates (`sm.json` ≡ `agents/sm.json`, `agents/sm_merge.json`, `agents/bulk_bugs_creation.json`) switch their tag-only-status gates from `{status.X:Lit}` to whole-clause `{stage.X:Lit}` forms. In `'none'` mode single-placeholder rules produce the byte-identical clause; two-status rules become the semantically equal `status in ('A') OR status in ('B')` (the stage machinery cannot emit a two-value `in` — accepted, behaviour-preserving).

{"content":"### Root Cause

On restricted workflows (ADO Test Case / ADO PBI), the test-automation statuses (`Passed`, `Failed`, `In Review - Passed/Failed`, `Skipped`, `Irrelevant`, `Bug To Fix`, `In Testing`, `Ready For Testing`, `Merged`) are tag-only. ~25 modules moved tickets with raw `tracker.moveToStatus(...)`, so ADO rejected the transition and the call sites swallowed the error — no status change, no `stage_*` marker, and `✅ Moved …` logs that lied. The shipped SM rules made it worse: their JQL gated on the same statuses, so tickets carrying only a `stage_*` marker were invisible, and `smAgent`'s `rule.targetStatus` move (Merged → Ready For Testing) hit the same raw call.

### Fix

- `js/common/trackers.js`: added `hasStage(ticket, stageKey, statusName)` — status match, or (label mode only) the `stage_<key>` marker; no label reads in the default `'none'` mode.
- Migrated every test-automation mover to `moveToStatusOrMark(key, STATUS, STAGE_KEY)` (`moveToInTesting`, `moveToReadyForTesting`, `post*Results`, `mergeStoryTestAutomationPR`, `retryMergePR`, `prepareTestPRForReview`, `check*Passed`, `checkBugToFixReady`, `checkTaskStoriesDone`, `finishTestCasesGeneration`, `storyTestAutomationRework`, `triggerBitriseTestAutomation`, `recover*`, `postBugCreation`, `postBulkBugsCreation`, `createBugFixBatchEpic`); dev-flow statuses (Done, Blocked, In Rework, In Review, Backlog, …) stay direct moves.
- Status-equality gates in the check/merge/PR modules now resolve through `hasStage(...)`.
- `sm.json` (≡ `agents/sm.json`), `agents/sm_merge.json`, `agents/bulk_bugs_creation.json`: tag-only-status gates switched to whole-clause `{stage.X:Literal}` placeholders; in `'none'` mode single-status rules expand byte-identical, two-status rules to the equivalent `status in ('A') OR status in ('B')`.
- `js/smAgent.js`: `rule.targetStatus` resolves against the tag-only stage set and falls back to `moveToStatusOrMark`; `js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js` mirrors `testRunner.js`'s `makeDefaultConfigLoaderMock` helpers.

Opt-in via the existing `jira.stageFallback: 'label'` / `customParams.stageFallback`; default `'none'` keeps today's behaviour.

### Test Coverage

- Reproduction tests per flow: rejected transitions in `'label'` mode now mark `stage_*` and the flow completes (e.g. `test_moveToInTesting`, `test_mergeStoryTestAutomationPR`, `test_retryMergePR`, `test_recoverMergedPRTicket`, `test_smAgent` targetStatus suites); `'none'`-mode tests pin the unchanged path.
- Full suite: 136 files from `run_all.json` — result recorded below.

### Notes

- `agents/` here is a self-symlink (consumer-layout shim, gitignored) — `sm.json` and `agents/sm.json` are one file.
- Two-status `{stage.*}` rules expand to two OR-ed clauses instead of one two-value `status in (...)` — same selection, different bytes, in `'none'` mode too.
- One pre-existing node-harness failure in `test_smAgent.js` (`assert.doesNotThrow` exists only in the GraalJS runner) is unrelated.
